new: Offline play is back: installed or in a tab, the game keeps a copy so it starts with no network. A preference, on by default; the menu bar shows how far the download is.
fixed: In Firefox, reloading or leaving a game with music on no longer hangs for ten seconds or more.
Music that can't play on this machine stops after two tries, instead of downloading the whole playlist again and again.

new: Start is almost instant: the game loads in the background while you set up your game.
A game in progress is saved when you switch away from the tab, and the start screen offers to resume it.
fixed: A new version reliably reaches browsercol.com. Before, the site sometimes kept the previous version after an update.
changed: Offline play is off for now while we fix it. The copy saved in your browser is removed, and each visit loads the newest version.

fixed: Playing offline, music that hasn't been downloaded is skipped quietly. Before, the music stopped for good at the first missing track.
changed: A new version keeps the music you downloaded for offline play, instead of downloading it again.

new: Installed as an app, BrowserCol plays offline.
Preferences can download the music, so it plays offline too. The sound effects come with the install.
fixed: The Colopedia no longer adds another Free Colonist to a nation's starting units each time you open Conquest, Building or Fur Trading.
A ship carrying two loads of the same goods shows both in the cargo report and in Europe, and a trade offers those goods once.
The labour report shows every place colonists work, even two places with the same name.
changed: "A new version is ready" sits under the menu bar, clear of the map's orders.

fixed: The trade route editor grows to fit the screen before it scrolls, so its OK button stays in view.
The trade route editor's dotted line reaches each stop again when a stop has many goods.

new: The first public release of BrowserCol.
